name: numeric-helpers
description: Clamp an integer, add signed 64-bit integers, and average two doubles.

exports.name: clamp_i32
exports.description: Clamp value to [minimum, maximum]; callers must provide minimum <= maximum.

exports.name: sum_i64
exports.description: Add two signed 64-bit integers; the mathematical sum must fit int64_t.

exports.name: mean_f64
exports.description: Return the arithmetic mean of two finite doubles.
